description_for_human: Search live job postings from 30+ ATS feeds and job boards as one normalized schema, and detect the technologies any company runs.
description_for_model: Use jobspipe to search live, normalized job postings (title, company, salary, location, remote, posted date) across 30+ sources, and to scan a company domain for its technology stack. Authenticate with a Bearer API key (prefix jp_live_) from https://jobspipe.dev/signup. A free no-auth sandbox lives under /v1/sandbox.
